title: Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**

  

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.  



  

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.  



  

**Are You the Right Fit?**

* A proven enterprise seller who has grown strategic accounts in Sweden, and who wants to lead the next wave of AI-driven customer experience?
* Skilled at finding expansion opportunities and turning trusted relationships into multi-year growth?
* Excited by Customer Experience, Agentic AI, and able to explain it in terms of business outcomes rather than features?
* Comfortable in the boardroom as well as the IT architecture review, across complex organizations?
* Commercially driven, strategic, and motivated by ambitious growth targets?

If so, we want to hear from you.  



  

**Why This Role, Why Now**

Customer experience is moving from scripted automation to AI agents that can reason, act and resolve issues on a customer's behalf. Most large Swedish enterprises already run Genesys Cloud. They now face the question of how to scale AI safely and prove its value, without fragmenting their CX estate across many point tools.


Genesys Cloud is the agentic orchestration platform for CX: one platform that coordinates AI agents, human employees and enterprise systems around a single customer journey. Genesys Cloud ARR is close to $2.9 billion, growing more than 30% year over year. Cloud AI ARR is growing at more than twice the rate of the wider cloud business. Our installed base is where much of that growth comes from, and you will own a share of it in Sweden.  



  

**Role Overview**

This is a strategic growth role focused on expanding Genesys' relationships with existing enterprise customers across the Swedish market. You will own a portfolio of key accounts and be accountable for increasing the value and impact of Genesys Cloud in each one.


You will build relationships across business and technology leadership, understand each customer's strategic priorities, and turn them into expansion, adoption and transformation opportunities. That means multi-year account plans, whitespace analysis, and leading complex upsell and cross-sell cycles. You own the commercial relationship and the growth strategy.


You will lead customers' move from today's contact centre and digital channels to AI-powered, orchestrated experiences. You will work closely with Customer Success, Presales, Professional Services, Partners and Product to make Genesys the strategic platform as their needs change.


You will help executives build the case for AI on measurable outcomes such as resolution rates, cost to serve, retention, agent productivity and customer satisfaction


.


**Key Responsibilities**

  

***Grow the installed base***

* Own and grow a portfolio of existing enterprise customers in Sweden, delivering consistent expansion revenue.
* Build and execute multi-year account plans that identify whitespace, growth opportunities and long-term customer priorities.
* Drive upsell and cross-sell across Genesys Cloud, including AI, agentic virtual agents, workforce engagement, analytics and adjacent offerings.
* Expand Genesys into new business units, use cases, geographies and stakeholder groups, and help customers move from AI pilots to enterprise-scale deployment.

Achieve and exceed expansion and existing-business revenue targets.  

* 

  

***Lead the agentic AI conversation***

* Position Genesys Cloud as the orchestration layer for AI agents, human employees and enterprise systems, and shape each customer's AI and CX roadmap.
* Build business cases that show measurable value and support investment decisions at CxO and board level.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business strategy, CX priorities, technology landscape and transformation roadmap.

Lead complex, consultative sales cycles from opportunity identification through negotiation and close.  

* 

  

***Build relationships and protect the base***

* Build strong relationships with senior executives, business leaders and technology stakeholders, including CIO, CCO and CX leaders.
* Partner with Customer Success to strengthen adoption, value realisation, retention and expansion.
* Work with Presales, Professional Services, Marketing, Product and Partners on account growth strategies.
* Manage renewals, competitive threats and barriers to growth proactively.
* Keep pipeline management disciplined and forecasts accurate across the portfolio.
* Complete a whitespace and AI-readiness assessment for every account in your portfolio, and agree executive-level account plans.
* Establish trusted relationships with senior business and technology sponsors in each key account.
* Build a qualified pipeline of AI and expansion opportunities that supports your target with healthy coverage.
* Close expansion deals that move customers from AI pilots to production, and secure renewals with growth.

Become a recognised voice for agentic AI in CX among Swedish customers and partners.  

* 

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of enterprise software sales or strategic account management in SaaS, AI, CCaaS or cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated success growing and expanding complex enterprise accounts in the Swedish market.
* Strong track record of delivering revenue through upsell, cross-sell and strategic account development.
* Proven ability to navigate large organisations and build relationships across stakeholders and executive levels.
* Experience leading complex, high-value commercial negotiations and enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong strategic account planning, pipeline management and forecasting skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and executive engagement skills.
* Ability to discuss AI, including its value, risks and governance, credibly with both business and technical audiences.
* Fluency in Swedish and English.

Willingness to travel frequently within Sweden and across the region.  

* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience growing strategic relationships in customer experience or contact centre technology.
* Familiarity with AI-driven solutions, including generative and agentic AI, cloud architectures and enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Experience developing multi-year account strategies for large, complex organizations.
* Strong understanding of enterprise digital transformation and CX initiatives.
* Experience working with Customer Success and partner ecosystems, such as hyperscalers, system integrators and CRM or ITSM vendors, to drive customer value and growth.

Experience selling value-based business cases for AI or automation programmes.  

* 

  

#LI-MC1  



  

**Working at Genesys**

* **AI at enterprise scale** – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
* **A flexible-first culture** – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
* **Growth in the AI era** – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
* **Time to recharge and give back** – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
* **Recognized globally** – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.  



  

**What Happens After You Apply**

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:


* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team.
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases.
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.  



  

**Stay Connected**

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.


Get notified about relevant opportunities .  



  

**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.**
====================================================================================

  

**Employee Referral**

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.  



  

**About Genesys:**

Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodations:**

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable.accommodations@genesys.com .  



  

You can expect a response within 24–48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email.  



This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation—such as application follow-ups or resume submissions—may not receive a response.  



  

**Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics.**

  

*Please note that recruiters will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information during the application phase.*

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**  

At H&M Group, we are on a journey to create great digital experiences for millions of customers around the world. Within Digital Foundation, E2E Digital Operations plays a key role in keeping our online customer journeys stable, resilient and continuously improving.


Evolved Digital Operations, or EDO, brings together end-to-end operational visibility, proactive monitoring, automation, incident management, service integration, Site Reliability Engineering and close collaboration with product teams. Together, we help reduce disruption, improve reliability and enable teams to deliver customer value with confidence.


As Senior Engineering Manager for E2E Digital Operations, you will lead the teams that run and evolve H&M’s end-to-end digital operations service. This is a senior leadership role where you will combine people leadership, technical direction and operational excellence to create the conditions for scalable, reliable and customer-focused digital services.


You will translate business and technology priorities into a clear service roadmap, align multiple teams around shared outcomes and balance immediate operational needs with long-term technical health, security, compliance, cost efficiency and resilience. You will also work closely with product, engineering, architecture, commercial stakeholders, service management functions and external partners to improve how we operate at scale.

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


You will lead E2E Digital Operations as one integrated service across three teams:

* Delivery Excellence
* Site Reliability Engineering
* Governance


Your main responsibilities will include:

**Service strategy and delivery**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap and technical delivery for EDO, connecting H&M Group priorities with clear, measurable outcomes.
* Set direction across multiple teams and make sure priorities, dependencies, risks and trade-offs are visible and actively managed.
* Balance delivery pace with service stability, resilience, security, compliance, technical health and long-term scalability.
* Build a clear maturity path for EDO, helping the service grow in efficiency, proficiency and operational excellence.
* Make sure teams have the skills, capacity, tooling and ways of working needed to deliver and run the service successfully.

**Operational excellence and reliability**

* Own RUN performance and continuous improvement for EDO, using service, reliability and engineering insights to guide decisions.
* Drive an integrated operating model across 24/7 operations, service integration, SRE, governance and product teams.
* Strengthen end-to-end observability across customer journeys, including monitoring, alert quality, incident detection, escalation and operational decision support.
* Improve incident, problem, change, event and knowledge management outcomes while keeping processes practical, lean and aligned with global standards.
* Promote proactive and preventive operations through automation, AI-enabled capabilities, effective problem management and reduced recurring operational work.
* Ensure operational readiness for new and changed services through clear requirements, onboarding, knowledge transfer, runbooks, access, simulations and follow-up.
* Turn incident learnings and operational data into sustained improvements in reliability, recovery and customer impact.

**Engineering and technical leadership**

* Shape and communicate the technical and operational direction for EDO, aligned with Digital Foundation and wider enterprise priorities.
* Set and uphold engineering standards across architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, security, compliance and technical debt management.
* Guide technical trade-offs across teams so that decisions support both current operational needs and the long-term target state.
* Stay close enough to the technology to challenge, support and coach engineering leaders and specialists without becoming a bottleneck for team-level decisions.
* Create clear interfaces between EDO Digital and product teams so accountability, escalation paths and expectations are easy to understand.

**People and organisational leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop Engineering Managers, senior engineers and other leaders across the scope, guided by H&M values and leadership expectations.
* Build a high-performing and inclusive culture where people collaborate well, take shared accountability and stay close to customer impact.
* Clarify roles, decision rights and accountability boundaries across teams to reduce overlap and enable faster execution.
* Drive workforce and competence planning, including recruitment, development, succession and sustainable workload balance.
* Encourage continuous improvement of ways of working, technical capability and operational maturity.

**Collaboration, partners and financial accountability**

* Act as the senior contact for EDO in enterprise-level planning, prioritisation and operational forums.
* Build strong partnerships across Digital Foundation, other product areas, business stakeholders and supporting functions to resolve cross-service challenges and improve the customer journey.
* Communicate clearly on outcomes, service performance, progress, risks, dependencies and investment needs.
* Be accountable for relevant technology costs, including budget, actuals and forecast, while continuously improving cost efficiency and total cost of ownership.

 **WHO YOU ARE**


We believe you are an experienced engineering leader who brings together strategic perspective, operational judgement and strong people leadership. You are confident leading through complexity and ambiguity, and you know how to align several teams and stakeholders around common goals. You believe that operational excellence is built through engineering discipline, learning, collaboration and purposeful simplification.

* Advanced engineering expertise and a strong understanding of the end-to-end development and operations lifecycle.
* Solid understanding of architecture, scalable design principles, cloud fundamentals and modern engineering practices.
* Proven ability to set technical direction and lead delivery across multiple teams or a large, complex service.
* Strong experience with RUN accountability, monitoring, incident management and SRE practices.
* Ability to use data, service measures and insights to improve performance and guide investment decisions.
* Experience managing technical debt, dependencies and risk across a complex technology landscape.
* Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing and deployment, and continuous improvement practices.
* Strong security and compliance awareness, with the ability to embed appropriate controls without creating unnecessary friction.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decisions across organisational boundaries.
* Experience leading and coaching managers, senior engineers and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience working with vendors, managed services and external partners in an enterprise environment.
* Financial acumen and experience managing technology budgets, forecasts and cost optimisation.
* Business understanding and the ability to communicate technical and operational topics in a clear, relevant way.
* Curiosity and enough technical depth to ask the right questions, challenge constructively and make sound trade-offs.

 **WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

* Staff discount card: Usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.
* H&M Incentive Program (HIP): Included in our HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.
* Competitive pensions: Collective Agreement and ITP pensions competitive to the Swedish market.
* Generous vacation: 30 days' vacation, health care allowance, and good work-life balance.
* Additional perks: Discounts from Benify.
* Innovative Environment: Work with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions.
* Global Impact: Be part of a team that influences users worldwide.
* Professional Growth: Endless opportunities to learn and develop your skills.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a motivated team that values collaboration and excellence.

 **JOIN US**


Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.


This is a full-time permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to the agreement. The role is a hybrid position, based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden.


Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through the career page.


Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. We are eager to meet you!

* We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: OpenShift Platform Engineer ﻿
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll**.*

  

  

### **Din roll**


Vill du vara med och bygga Saabs applikationsplattform för miljöer med höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och kontroll? Vi söker en OpenShift Platform Engineer med gedigen erfarenhet av OpenShift, Kubernetes och automation samt erfarenhet från cloud-, on-prem- eller edge-miljöer. I rollen arbetar du med hela plattformens livscykel, från design och etablering till drift, uppgraderingar och vidareutveckling. Tillsammans med teamet bygger du en säker, automatiserad och självbetjänad plattform som gör det enklare för våra utvecklingsteam att utveckla, leverera och köra applikationer.

  

  

Du arbetar praktiskt med applikationsplattformen och dess underliggande infrastruktur i miljöer som spänner från molntjänster och datacenter till lokala installationer. Du ansvarar för att plattformen är stabil, säker och utvecklas utifrån verksamhetens behov, i nära samarbete med arkitekter, drift- och utvecklingsteam.

  

  

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

  

  

* Designa, installera och förvalta plattformsmiljöer i cloud-, on-prem- och edge-miljöer.
* Automatisera etablering, konfiguration och livscykelhantering med Infrastructure as Code och GitOps.
* Utveckla självbetjäningsfunktioner, integrationer och CI/CD-flöden.
* Arbeta med nätverk, lagring, säkerhet och identitetshantering i Kubernetes- och OpenShift-miljöer.
* Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet genom övervakning, loggning, incidenthantering och kapacitetsplanering.
* Genomföra uppgraderingar samt förvalta rutiner för backup, återställning och drift.
  

  

Det här är en möjlighet att komma in i ett team under uppbyggnad och vara med och forma både arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar. Saab befinner sig i en intensiv digitaliseringsresa där modernisering, automation och AI spelar en viktig roll. Du får vara med och bygga plattformar som skapar förutsättningar för framtidens utveckling samtidigt som du verkar i en miljö där säkerhet och robusthet alltid är centrala.

  

  

### **Din profil**


Vi söker dig som har flerårig erfarenhet av plattformsdrift i produktionsmiljö och som har arbetat praktiskt med OpenShift och Kubernetes. Du har erfarenhet av att installera, uppgradera och felsöka plattformar över flera tekniska lager, från Linux och nätverk till kluster och applikationer.

  

  

Du drivs av att automatisera repetitiva arbetsuppgifter och ser plattformen som en produkt som skapar värde för sina användare. Samtidigt förstår du utvecklingsteamens behov och vikten av säker, tillförlitlig och effektiv drift.

  

  

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

  

  

* Gedigen erfarenhet av Red Hat OpenShift 4.x i produktionsmiljö.
* God förståelse för Kubernetesarkitektur och centrala OpenShift-komponenter.
* Kunskap inom klusternätverk, DNS, lastbalansering och nätverkspolicyer.
* Goda kunskaper i Linux samt erfarenhet av felsökning inom nätverk och TLS.
* Erfarenhet av plattformsdrift inom cloud-, on-prem- eller edge-miljöer.
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, CI/CD och containerteknik.
* Erfarenhet av övervakning, logghantering och automation.
  

  

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  

  

* Frånkopplade miljöer och OpenShift-installationer i komplexa infrastrukturer.
* Distribuerad lagring, exempelvis Ceph eller OpenShift Data Foundation.
* Policy as Code, secrets management och plattformssäkerhet.
* Observability-lösningar som Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch eller OpenTelemetry.
* Multiklusterhantering inom OpenShift-ekosystemet.
* AWS, Azure eller Google Cloud samt hybridmiljöer.
* Virtualisering, service mesh eller AI/ML-arbetslaster.
* Reglerade verksamheter och säkerhetskrav.
* Relevanta certifieringar inom OpenShift, Kubernetes, Linux eller cloud.
  

  

Som person är du strukturerad, ansvarstagande och lösningsorienterad. Du samarbetar gärna över teamgränser, delar med dig av din kunskap och kan kommunicera tekniska vägval till olika målgrupper. För dig är dokumentation, säkerhet och kvalitet självklara delar av arbetet.

  

  

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap*.

  

  

### **Vad du blir en del av**


Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

  

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

  

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Senior Product Engineer | Content Delivery
description:
At TV4, technology, innovation, journalism, sports and entertainment come together.


Every week, around eight million people use TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo. Before a single programme reaches them, it has to travel through a long chain of systems: received, processed, prepared, published and delivered.


We are now looking for a **Senior Product Engineer** to join the Media Supply Tech team in Content Delivery, the area that builds and operates the systems moving content from planning and preparation to TV4 Play, MTV Katsomo and linear television.

**Before you apply**

*To be considered, you need to already have the right to work and reside in Sweden and be able to work office-first from Stockholm. We are not able to offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.*

**Why you might want to join**
------------------------------


Everything TV4 puts on screen, from production companies to broadcast, flows through us. You will work at the heart of media delivery, modernising systems that keep running every day, so content reaches viewers faster, with fewer manual steps and more of the knowledge and ownership inside TV4.


Here, you will work closely with the people who depend on our systems. All of them are colleagues, so you can see how they actually work and build what makes their day better.


You are curious about how media gets from A to B at TV4, and want to understand the whole delivery process, not just your own part of it.


You see AI as a natural part of modern software development. We build with agentic tools every day, and we keep our hands on the wheel: people decide how the system should work, and AI executes.

**About the team**
------------------


Our part of the chain is the media supply: the ecosystem that receives, processes, prepares and moves media between systems. Keeping that flow reliable is the foundation of everything we do.


But we are also building what comes next. The team is inventing and developing a completely new, automated playout system, one that challenges conventional broadcast technology by using the cloud and AI.


In practice, you will work on the whole chain: reliable ingest with retries and failure handling, event-driven workflows and queues that run processing and transcoding jobs, storage and cost optimisation for large volumes of video, and a steady flow of new integrations and features.


The team works where engineering, operations and production meet. What we do, in the end, is solve problems. Collaboration is important to us: we solve them together, within the team and with the people who feel them.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build and evolve the services that move media through TV4's delivery process
* Find manual steps and handovers in the flow, and automate them away
* Work closely with users and stakeholders to understand what they need, and let the value for them guide what you build
* Simplify a landscape of systems and integrations that has grown over many years
* Contribute to architectural decisions and technical direction across the media supply chain
* Take responsibility for your services in production, including monitoring and continuous improvement
* Use AI tools actively as part of the development process

**About you**
-------------


You are a motivated and growth-minded engineer who takes ownership. When you pick something up, you see it through from start to finish, and you care about whether it actually helped someone.


Engaging with people across the organisation comes naturally, whether they are engineers, operators or producers. Collaboration is important to us, and you make the people around you better, listen as much as you build, and bring others along.


With a strong grasp of the big picture, you can put yourself in the shoes of a user or a colleague in another team. The value you create for them comes first, and the technology follows.


We also believe that you:

* Have solid engineering fundamentals from building and operating software across the stack, so you can judge what AI produces
* Communicate clearly and make complex things easy to understand
* Have experience working in modern cloud-based product environments
* Have adopted AI and agentic development as a tool for improving quality, learning and productivity


Experience from streaming, broadcast or media technology is a plus, but not a requirement. Come with curiosity and a will to learn, and you will pick up the rest with us.

**Our current tech stack**
--------------------------


Depending on what you work on, you may encounter:

* TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Rust, React and Next.js
* AWS
* MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis/Valkey, DynamoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch

title: Kvalitetsingenjör
description:
Kvalitetsingenjör – var med och forma nästa generations kraftlösningar för AI På Flex Power Modules i Kalmar utvecklar vi avancerade kraftmoduler som används i några av världens mest krävande plattformar för AI och cloud computing. Vi hjälper teknikföretag att möta det växande effektbehovet i nästa generations IT-infrastruktur, där prestanda, effektivitet och tillförlitlighet är avgörande. För att fortsätta flytta gränserna inom kraftelektronik söker vi nu en kvalitetsingenjör som vill vara med och påverka hur framtidens produkter utvecklas, verifieras och sätts i produktion. Vilka utmaningar står vi inför?
  
  

Vår R&D-organisation består idag av sex utvecklingsteam och är snart på väg att bli sju. Varje år lägger vi betydande resurser på att validera våra produkters prestanda, tillförlitlighet och kvalitet. Utmaningen är inte bara att hitta problem, utan framför allt att förebygga dem genom att identifiera risker tidigt, stärka våra utvecklingsmetoder och hjälpa våra team att fatta bättre beslut genom hela produktutvecklingen. Resultatet är robustare produkter, färre sena överraskningar och bättre långsiktig kvalitet för våra kunder.
  
  

Du kommer att arbeta nära konstruktörer, projektledare, tillförlitlighetsingenjörer och andra specialister för att identifiera risker, utmana antaganden, stärka våra utvecklingsprocesser och förbättra produkternas kvalitet långt innan de når den formella kvalificeringen. I slutändan handlar din framgång om en sak: Att hjälpa våra produkter genom utveckling och kvalificering på ett smidigt sätt genom att bidra till att rätt beslut fattas tidigt. Vem är du? Du är nyfiken på varför produkter går sönder och brinner för att hitta sätt att förhindra att det händer.
  
  

Du tycker om att arbeta nära ingenjörer och att påverka tekniska beslut, men framför allt vill du hjälpa teamen att lyckas. Oavsett om din bakgrund är inom kvalitet, tillförlitlighet, produktutveckling, provning, tillverkning eller något annat tekniskt område är vi intresserade av att höra hur dina erfarenheter skulle kunna stärka vår utvecklingsorganisation. Hur skulle du kunna bidra? Vi är nyfikna på dina erfarenheter och intressen och på hur du tror att du skulle kunna bidra till vår fortsatta utveckling: Vilken typ av kvalitetsutmaningar motiverar dig?
  
  

Vilka styrkor skulle du bidra med till vårt R&D-kvalitetsteam? Hur skulle du kunna hjälpa våra utvecklingsteam att leverera robusta produkter snabbare? Om det här låter som den typ av utmaning du söker vill vi gärna höra från dig.

title: Data & Machine Learning Engineer ﻿
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*  

  



### **Your role**


We are looking for a talented and driven Data & Machine Learning Engineer to join our Airborne Early Warning (AEW) organization and help shape the future of data-driven development, testing, verification, and evaluation for one of the world's most advanced Airborne Early Warning & Control (AEW&C) systems, GlobalEye.

  

  

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Machine Learning, helping establish and grow our data and machine learning capabilities. As part of an emerging area within the organization, you will develop technical solutions, explore new ways of working, and support the adoption of modern data-driven methods across engineering teams.

  

  

The primary focus of this role is to build and improve data pipelines, analytics capabilities, and machine learning solutions using data generated throughout the development and testing of the GlobalEye system. You will collaborate closely with test engineers, systems engineers, software developers, product owners, and domain experts to transform complex technical data into actionable insights and scalable solutions.

  

  

As a Data & Machine Learning Engineer, you will:


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines for engineering and product data.
* Develop and improve machine learning workflows and supporting infrastructure.
* Analyze complex datasets and create solutions that generate measurable value for engineering and development teams.
* Collaborate with systems engineers, software developers, product owners, and domain experts across the organization.
* Help establish and mature data-driven ways of working.
* Identify opportunities where analytics, automation, and machine learning can improve engineering processes, product quality, and decision-making.
* Contribute to initiatives from concept through implementation and operational use.
* Support colleagues and stakeholders in understanding and adopting data, analytics, and machine learning methodologies.
  

  

### **Your profile**


We believe that success in this role is driven as much by mindset as by technical expertise. You are a self-driven, problem-solving, and proactive person who takes ownership of your work and thrives in environments where structures and ways of working continue to evolve. With a curious mindset and a passion for continuous learning, you enjoy exploring new technologies and approaches.

  

  

You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, creating clarity when needed, and driving initiatives forward both independently and together with others. Most importantly, you are motivated by solving complex challenges, creating value through practical solutions, and helping others embrace opportunities within data, AI, and machine learning.

  

  

Required Qualifications


* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline.
* Experience in software development, data engineering, analytics, machine learning, or a similar technical field.
* Experience developing solutions using Python and modern data processing or machine learning frameworks.
* Understanding of data pipelines, data modeling, and modern data processing concepts.
* Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across technical and executive business domains.
  

  

Meritorious Experience


* Experience with sensor data, sensor fusion, or real-time data processing.
* Experience working with complex technical products or systems in highly engineered environments.
* Knowledge of MLOps practices, model deployment, and workflow automation.
* Experience with cloud-based Data & AI platforms
* Experience with technologies such as Delta Lake, Iceberg, Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Dagster, MLflow, PyTorch, Pandas, JAX or other large-scale data & machine learning tools.
* Military service and/or defence-related experience.
  

  

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

  

### **What you will be part of**


Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

  

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 30,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

  

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

  

  

*We look forward to receiving your application. Please include your CV, cover letter, and any relevant transcripts or certificates that showcase your qualifications and experience.*

title: Director Research Programs & Consortia Medical Imaging
description:
Are you a business-minded research professional with deep expertise in medical imaging who thrives in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment? Do you enjoy combining scientific and technical expertise with commercial understanding, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes? Collective Minds is looking for a Director, Research Programs & Consortia to drive our portfolio of public and private research collaborations. This is a broad, hands-on role with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact in a growing international healthtech company.
  
  

About Collective Minds Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.
  
  

About the role As Director, Research Programs & Consortia, you will take responsibility for our portfolio of more than 10 public and private research consortia, which are a key part of Collective Minds' strategy and ongoing delivery. Working alongside CROs, biotech and medtech companies, pharmaceutical partners, academic hospitals and research organizations, these collaborations span medical imaging, big data, analytics, and AI modeling and validation across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research. Within these projects, Collective Minds acts as a data manager and platform provider, bringing deep expertise in medical imaging to support complex research collaborations. You will be responsible for successful project delivery, reporting and project close-outs, while coordinating project and research managers across our customer delivery organization.
  
  

You will act as a playing coach andpersonally manage selected research consortia and contribute scientific and technical expertise when needed. This is a broad, hands-on role where you will combine scientific expertise with commercial understanding, set priorities and drive results through collaboration. You will ensure projects are delivered efficiently, within agreed scope and with a clear focus on quality and business value. Your main responsibilities: Drive the research project portfolio, ensuring successful delivery within agreed budgets, timelines, scope and commitments.
  
  

Coordinate project and research managers, aligning priorities, following up on progress and ensuring accountability across projects. Personally manage selected research consortia, including scientific, technical and operational activities. Provide scientific and technical guidance across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation. Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development.
  
  

Manage budgets, project scope and stakeholder expectations, balancing scientific objectives with commercial priorities. Ensure accurate reporting to customers, funders and partners, including grant deliverables and efficient project close-outs. Collaborate with clinical and technical operations teams to plan capacity, resolve challenges and continuously improve project delivery. Who are we looking for?
  
  

We are looking for a scientifically experienced and business-minded professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with a strong track record of delivering complex research projects. You are analytical, pragmatic and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, making decisions and finding effective solutions without adding unnecessary complexity. You communicate clearly, build trust with internal and external stakeholders and know how to balance scientific quality with business priorities and efficient execution.
  
  

**We believe you have:** A strong scientific background in life sciences, medical sciences, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research. Experience from a commercial life sciences, medtech, biotech, pharma, CRO or healthtech environment, including scientific and academic collaborations. Proven experience managing complex research programs or consortia, including budgets, timelines, scope, reporting and project close-outs. Hands-on experience with research consortia, work package delivery, grant writing, grant execution and funding-related reporting.
  
  

Strong technical skills, including scientific programming, analytical tools and data-driven research workflows. The ability to assess complex scientific and technical requirements, make informed decisions and contribute to technical implementations when needed. Commercial awareness and the ability to balance scientific objectives with budgets, resources and project commitments. Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive results across teams and external partners.
  
  

A proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt quickly and take initiative. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Willingness to travel internationally as required by research projects, typically approximately every two months. Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.
  
  

Why join Collective Minds? At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare. You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done. This is an opportunity to take responsibility for a strategically important research portfolio, work with leading scientific and industry partners and contribute to the continued growth of an international healthtech company.
  
  

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Engineering Manager - Pricing Foundation

The role partners with Product Managers in product contexts and owns delivery and roadmap in service contexts. The EM combines delivery accountability with people leadership and has the mandate to make technical decisions aligned with strategy.

 **ABOUT THE TEAM**


The Pricing Foundation Team is a global product development team at H&M Group, driving the future of pricing across our brands and markets. We bring together product, business, engineering, quality assurance, analytics, and design expertise to build scalable solutions that enable accurate, automated, and data-driven pricing decisions. Working across Stockholm and Bangalore, we collaborate closely as one team to deliver business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Our team owns the core pricing platform that powers H&M Group's global pricing operations. We are responsible for developing and evolving services that ensure consistent, scalable, and reliable pricing across brands, channels, and markets. title: Martech Engineer
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a Martech Engineer for the next phase of growth.

##### **About the Role**


In this role, you will take full ownership of the technology bridging our marketing performance with core business results. You will bring our tracking, consent management, and attribution infrastructure completely in-house, scaling our financial systems to optimize performance marketing toward real business outcomes like active card customers and paid-out loans.

##### **Key responsibilities**

* Own and manage end-to-end web and server-side Google Tag Manager (Stape), GA4, and OneTrust setups, ensuring full compliance with Consent Mode v2 and GDPR.
* Build and maintain Conversion APIs (CAPI) and offline conversion data pipelines across major channels to align bidding models with downstream financial metrics.
* Establish UTM governance and attribution logic to reconcile platform data with our central cloud data warehouse.
* Consolidate marketing data architecture across Fivetran, Funnel, BigQuery, and Redshift, streamlining pipeline efficiency and data hygiene.
* Support cross-functional initiatives across Digital, RevOps, and Web teams for channel launches, experimentation, and data troubleshooting.

##### **What we’re looking for**


You bring a structured, engineering-led mindset to marketing data infrastructure and take pride in documenting scalable systems. You have the technical rigor to debug complex setups, the initiative to drive complete in-house alignment, and the ability to translate complex tracking setups into clear, actionable business insights.

##### **Qualifications**

* Several years of experience in a specialized Martech, tracking, or marketing engineering role within a data-driven setting.
* Deep hands-on experience with web and server-side Google Tag Manager, GA4, OneTrust, and Consent Mode v2 implementation.
* Proven track record implementing Conversion APIs, offline conversion pipelines, and navigating attribution model discrepancies.
* Strong SQL skills combined with practical experience using data integration tools (Fivetran, Funnel) and cloud warehouses (BigQuery or Redshift).
* Background in Fintech, Banking, or another regulated, high-growth environment is a strong advantage.

##### **Why Qred?**


This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!

##### **One Last Thing**


This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.

*Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.*

title: Product and R&D Director
description:
*Are you an experienced software engineering leader who enjoys combining technology, product development and people leadership? At AddSecure, you will shape the future of GroupTalk, turning customer needs into clear product priorities and driving the development of reliable communication solutions.*

**AddSecure** is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and end-to-end solutions. We help our customers optimise their operations, create business value and protect critical functions.

**GroupTalk** is part of AddSecure's Smart Alarms business unit and provides Push-to-Talk communication services over mobile networks, helping organisations stay connected when reliable communication matters most.

###### **About the role**


As **Product and R&D Director**, you will lead the GroupTalk product and R&D team, combining product strategy, engineering leadership and people management.


Your main challenge will be to translate customer needs into clear product priorities, balance new development with maintenance and security requirements, and ensure that available engineering resources are used effectively.


You will lead a team of software, hardware and product professionals based in Uppsala. The role is based across our Stockholm and Uppsala offices, with approximately half of your working time spent at each location. You will report to the Chief Product Officer of Smart Alarms and participate in the CTO and CPO leadership teams.

**Your key responsibilities**

* Lead and develop your team, fostering collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Drive product strategy and roadmaps, ensuring alignment with customer needs and business objectives.
* Structure and prioritise product requirements based on customer value, business impact and technical feasibility.
* Plan and allocate engineering resources, balancing new product development with maintenance, security and operational needs.
* Oversee product development and delivery, ensuring quality, reliability and predictable execution.
* Improve engineering practices and collaborate with Sales, Operations and other stakeholders to support product performance.

###### **About you**


We are looking for a technically strong leader with a background in software engineering who has developed towards R&D leadership and product management. You combine technical understanding with business judgement and enjoy creating structure, setting priorities and turning plans into results.


You are a collaborative and pragmatic leader who communicates clearly, makes well-informed decisions and enables your team to succeed.

**We believe you bring:**

* At least 5 years of experience in software engineering, software development or a related technical field.
* At least 3 years of leadership experience within R&D, engineering or product development.
* Experience in product management, product roadmaps, requirements prioritisation and resource planning.
* Solid understanding of software development, agile methodologies and engineering practices.
* Ability to balance customer value, technical complexity and available development capacity.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A relevant technical degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

**It would be an advantage if you also have:**

* Experience as an R&D Manager, Engineering Manager or similar.
* Knowledge of telecom, IoT, mobile applications or cloud services.
* Experience with hardware and software integration or mission-critical communication solutions.
* Experience working in an international organisation.

###### **We offer**


Our people are our greatest asset, and building a culture where colleagues thrive and feel motivated is essential to us. You will join an engaged, international team within a growing organisation. In addition, we offer:

* Wellness allowance
* Occupational pension
* Enhanced parental leave benefits
* Health checks
* Parking facilities

###### **We're all change makers!**


If you're looking for an organisation where you can be yourself, have fun at work, and contribute to a safer, smarter, and more sustainable world, AddSecure may be the place for you. Join our growing international team, where every day offers an opportunity to make a real difference.


Would you like to take part in our journey? Please apply by submitting your CV and answering a few short questions. We look forward to receiving your application.


We use a competence-based recruitment process that may include psychometric assessments, interviews, reference checks, and background checks. As part of the process, candidates may complete assessments provided by Alva Labs to support a fair and structured evaluation.  

  

We conduct background checks for all our employees, and you must be eligible to work in Sweden.
